Starting a round by entering an item in a multi-line field does not conflict with other stories.
Viewing all items for the session does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.
Selecting an item to estimate is not inconsistent with any other story.
Adding an item during play does not conflict with other constraints or rules.
Editing an item is not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game, so that I can see the stories and estimates
evaluations.rationale: Viewing game transcripts (stories and estimates) implies stored identifiable result data; this conflicts with PP-052 which requires results to be stored in a non-identifiable way unless transcripts are anonymized (incompatibility between storing identifiable transcripts and non-identifiable storage).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting a transcript (likely including estimates and identifiers) conflicts with PP-052's rule that results be stored non-identifiably unless exports are anonymized.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export of transcripts implies stored identifiable mappings between estimators and estimates, conflicting with PP-052's non-identifiable storage requirement.
Deleting a game and its stories/estimates does not conflict with other rules.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Creating accounts with identifiable PII conflicts with PP-052's requirement that results be stored non-identifiably unless account data and result storage are separated or anonymized; the stories impose incompatible storage/identifiability expectations.
Logging in using account name and password is an authentication behavior that does not by itself conflict with other stories.
Changing account details does not impose incompatible constraints with other stories.
Deleting an account (and its games) is compatible with other stories and does not create an inconsistency.
Showing dates/times in local timezone does not conflict with other stories.
Providing password reminders by email does not impose incompatible rules with other stories.
Selecting estimation scale options does not conflict with other system rules.
Inviting up to 15 estimators is a constraint but not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name
evaluations.rationale: Joining by entering a name implies capturing identifiable participant information; this conflicts with PP-052's requirement that results be stored non-identifiably unless the system explicitly separates/transforms identity before storage.
Seeing the item being estimated is a UI requirement that does not conflict with other stories' rules.
Seeing all items planned for the session does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Showing which specific estimator has given an estimate implies identity association; this can conflict with PP-052's requirement to store results non-identifiably unless identity is not persisted or is anonymized for storage.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This requires estimates to be revealed only after all have given, which is incompatible with PP-009 where the moderator can show all estimates immediately before everyone has estimated.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Allowing changes until the last person selects (and all are shown then) conflicts with PP-009 which permits the moderator to show all estimates immediately (potentially preventing changes earlier).

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Displaying per-estimator prior estimates implies storing identifiable histories; this conflicts with PP-052's non-identifiable storage requirement unless the histories are anonymized, which the stories do not specify.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Seeing who gave what implies associating identities with estimates; this can conflict with PP-052's rule that results be stored non-identifiably unless identity is not persisted or is anonymized for storage.
Starting a shared two-minute timer is not inconsistent with other stories.
Resetting the two-minute timer when all play an estimate is compatible with other stories.
Scrolling back through prior rounds' stories and estimates does not, by itself, impose an incompatible constraint.
Keeping card order consistent across draws does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Allowing changes until the draw is completed assumes draws complete when all estimates are shown; PP-009 (moderator may show all estimates immediately) can make a draw complete earlier, which is incompatible with this participant expectation.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying thumbnail photos ties visual identity to estimates and implies storing identifiable images; this conflicts with PP-052's requirement that results be stored non-identifiably unless photos/identity are excluded from stored results or anonymized.
Complying with XHTML/CSS standards does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.
Having a list of definitions is not in conflict with any other story.
Creating database indexes for performance does not conflict with other stories' behaviors or constraints.
Supporting older browsers is a compatibility requirement, not conflicting with other requirements.
Complying with accessibility guidelines does not create incompatibilities with other stories.
Performance/responsiveness expectations do not conflict with other stories.
Unicode support is compatible with other requirements.
Sensible and predictable URLs do not conflict with other stories.
Providing nice error pages is not inconsistent with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: Results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Mandating non-identifiable storage of results conflicts with many stories that require identifying who gave which estimate, account creation, transcripts and exports unless those features are specifically implemented anonymized; the requirement is incompatible with storing identifiable transcripts/exports and per-estimator histories as stated.
Seeing usage metrics is not inherently incompatible with other stories; metrics can be aggregated non-identifiably if needed.
